environment.description: Django REST API deployed on EC2 instance (i-0a3f7c2e) in VPC vpc-9d8e7f6a with no egress filtering. Instance has IAM role with ec2:DescribeInstances and s3:GetObject permissions. Application runs behind an ALB with no WAF attached. settings.SIGNING_KEY is loaded from AWS Secrets Manager at boot time and held in process memory as a plaintext string. Instance metadata service v1 (IMDSv1) is enabled, allowing unauthenticated GET to http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/. No network policy restricts outbound requests from the application container.
